title: crow-international
label: "Equaliser" Rob the Rock

won.source: Won the title from “Ego” Alex Nelson at Schools Out For Summer with the Brooklyn Bomb.

note: Retained the title in a ladder match at Scorch Wave 98 and is still listed as champion on the promotion's own 28 October 1998 ranking sheet.

title: crow-international
label: "Ego" Alex Nelson

won.source: Recorded from the broadcast's own commentary as reigning champion entering the 26 July 1998 defense, won 'just two weeks ago' from Pakradja.

note: Lost the title to Rob the Rock after the Destroyer's interference, meant for the challenger, struck the champion instead.

title: crow-light-heavyweight
label: Smoke

won.source: Won the title in the Light Heavyweight battle royal at Schools Out For Summer.

note: Stripped of the title during the promotion's own mid-1998 reorganization, per the promotion's own 30 August 1998 post-PPV update.

won.source: Recorded as the reigning champion entering the 26 July 1998 battle royal.

title: crow-light-heavyweight
label: "Lightning" Levi Ash

won.source: First confirmed as champion on the promotion's own 28 October 1998 ranking sheet; no surviving document dates the title change itself.

note: The promotion's own 30 August broadcast credits Giant Leopard with winning the vacated title outright, while the same day's post-PPV update instead describes a decider match still pending on another federation's card; no surviving document reconciles the two accounts or shows how Levi Ash came to hold it by October.

title: crow-television
label: "DD" Derek Douglas

won.source: Won the vacant title at Schools Out For Summer, defeating Bishop Jeremy Jackson.

note: Shown losing the title to Shawn Jamison in footage replayed during the promotion's own 28 October 1998 press conference; no surviving document dates the match itself.

won.source: Already billed as champion by the promotion's own 30 August 1998 broadcast; confirmed again on its 28 October ranking sheet.

title: crow-tag-team
label: The Gospel Preachers

won.source: The broadcast's own commentary at Scorch Wave 98: 'The Gospel Preachers have held the CROW Tag Team Titles since May 98.'

note: Lost the titles to Element Of Pain with the Destroyer's ringside interference, their first loss in twelve matches by the broadcast's own account.

title: crow-tag-team
label: Element Of Pain

won.source: Won the titles from the Gospel Preachers at Scorch Wave 98.

note: Still listed as champions on the promotion's own 28 October 1998 ranking sheet.

title: crow-world-heavyweight
label: King Dare

won.source: Won the title from Mad Goat at Scorch Wave 98, 2 falls to 1, in a falls-count-anywhere match.

note: Still listed as champion on the promotion's own 28 October 1998 ranking sheet.

won.source: Recorded from footage of an earlier CROW pay-per-view, 'Lord of the Ring,' replayed at the top of Schools Out For Summer, showing Mad Goat retaining the title in a three-way elimination Hell in a Cell match; that earlier card is not otherwise present in the held record.
